subject.title: Suggest closest edit match when oldText is missing

question: Should this PR remain a candidate for the edit mismatch diagnostics output, or should maintainers route the canonical implementation through the newer sibling PR for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97032?
rationale: Multiple open PRs implement overlapping user-facing diagnostics, and automation should not choose the final wording or canonical branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use newer canonical PR
options.body: Prefer the current-head, proof-sufficient sibling path after checks are clean, and ask this PR to rebase or close after that lands.

options.title: Keep this PR as candidate
options.body: Require current-head proof and a rebase, then compare its lighter closest-match output against the newer sibling implementation.

options.title: Request combined branch
options.body: Ask for one final narrow branch that keeps bounded scanning while adopting the maintainer-approved diagnostic wording.

recommendation.title: Use newer canonical PR
recommendation.body: Prefer the current-head, proof-sufficient sibling path after checks are clean, and ask this PR to rebase or close after that lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete carried the current session edit-tool surface into the runtime and is the strongest history-backed owner for choosing the output contract.
